title: Chapter 975
paragraphs: Chapter 975
Episode 241. Rescue (4)
'Did he just call us brothers?'
Jin was suddenly reminded of the day he first met Ameris.

The Red Plutonian and Blue Plutonian, although both part of the same Myeongwang tribe, had completely different goals. The Blue Plutonian tribe had a command structure similar to the current Myeongwang tribe, and the Red Plutonian tribe sought to resurrect the sun god, while the Blue Plutonian tribe sought to prevent it.
In that sense, Eltiot hadn't given Jin a bad feeling from the start.
Zap-!
Sigmund unleashed a golden lightning bolt. The barrage that was coming down on Eltiot suddenly collided with the lightning and vanished.

Then, a series of light-speed thrusts shot down the fleet that had been pressing Eltiot from the sky. The debris of the ships poured down like rain, but Jin had already closed the distance with Eltiot before a single fragment hit the ground.
'Did he mistake me for his brother and was forcing himself to hold on until I arrived?'
His pulse was faint, and his breath was weak. If Jin had been even a little later, Eltiot would have died or been captured by the Red Plutonian tribe and turned into a living blood factory.
Jin ignored the fleet filling the sky and examined Eltiot's condition for a while. The barrage continued, but not a single shot penetrated the golden lightning and the shield.
'He's on the verge of losing his breath, but I feel an unusually strong magical power from the Gwangsimjang. I've never heard Ameris mention the Blue Plutonian tribe using magic.'
Then it must be an external magic. Upon closer inspection, something like a dark worm-like energy was wriggling inside the Gwangsimjang.
He was reminded of the corpses of Blue Plutonian tribe buried members that he found in a hideout on Lutero Federation's uninhabited island earlier.
'The Imperial Family has tricked Eeja to utilize him. Judging by its form, it's crude but a powerful curse.'
A handful of glowing magic floated above Jin's palm.
He couldn't break the curse right now, but he could temporarily stop it. When Jin touched the Gwangsimjang and injected magic, the dark energy inside solidified like ice.
[Cough...!]
Eltiot spit up blood and opened his eyes.
"Have you come to your senses?"
[Bro... Brother... What happened to me?]
"It must be hard for you to talk, so I will ask just one thing. Please tell me your name and identity."
[Brother... Why are you acting like you don't know me...?]
"He seems to have not fully woken up yet."
[There's someone over there as powerful as a brother... But he's not our brother.]
He meant Luke.
At that moment, Jin inexplicably let out a quiet laugh. Luke uses a type of mental energy more similar to the Blue Plutonian or the current Myeongwang, but he's not considered a brother.
"I'm curious why I'm a brother, and he's not."
[The Sun God Religion... Those dreaming of the Sun's resurrection... Foolish people.]
"Ah, I understand. Now rest without worry."
Eltiot closed his eyes again. Thanks to the curse being stopped, his breathing sounded more stable than before.
Jin planted the sword he was holding, Sigmund, next to Eltiot. The four-bladed Myeongwang Sword, Erosion, was to protect Eltiot while he fought.
Pzztzzz...!
Around Sigmund, a thunder zone was forming. In the blink of an eye, thousands of lightning bolts rained down, and the Red Plutonian could no longer see Eltiot.
"It's not teleportation, just a powerful shield! Eltiot is still inside, so concentrate your firepower and kill him somehow! Pibil will support us!"
For the Red Plutonian, capturing Eltiot alive had to be abandoned for now. That was fine. They could still absorb his body and remaining blood even if they killed him.
However, this was less a realistic plan modification and more a decision to cling to a faint hope till the end.
The monster that had pushed past Pibil's main cannon and even Bakalun, who was trying to protect him, was guarding Eltiot.
Jin deactivated the shield in the sky and drew Bradamante. Simultaneously with the sword swing, a dark sword qi slashed horizontally across the sky.

Soul Cutter, a celestial slash that the mobility of a battleship could never react to. As the black sword qi silently passed the fleet, a belated explosion rang out. The sound of the ships being destroyed.
Jin was more conscious of Luke than Pibil and the fleet.
'He's also fighting while protecting something. It looks like the remnants of the royal family and the forces of the Sun God Religion... I'll have to check directly when my sister comes.'
Luna was still in the red thunderstorm that Pibil's main cannon had unleashed.

Bakalun's lieutenant had decided to focus on Luna rather than Jin. Even if Jin had reached a celestial level and was untouchable, targeting only Luna might deal a significant blow. That was the judgment.
"They made that decision not knowing how strong my sister is."
At that moment when Jin spoke, one side of the thunderstorm twisted, revealing Luna.
Her aura was swirling like a storm around her, almost to the limit, powerful enough to slightly alter the trajectory of the red lightning bolt that Pibil had fired.

"They seem to be taking us very lightly... Lowering their firepower? They think they can fight cautiously, thinking about what comes after, even when facing Runcandel's High Priest and first warrior?"
Luna's angry voice shook the battlefield. She was furiously slashing her enormous sword aura in mid-air, using its thrust to approach Pibil.
Around that time, Bakarun also escaped from the electric field, gathering his energy. He, like Luna, was unharmed, but he seemed visibly shaken.
The fact that the 'duel' ability was broken so easily, and that Luna, who was subjected to Pibil's concentrated bombardment, was unharmed except for a few faint scratches, was shocking.

'Indeed, the will of the Dreke tribes and the opinions of the Shimat tribes were right... If we had continued to wage war with Vamel instead of Lutero, there would be no name of the enemy tribe left in this world.'
Screech-!
Krantel struck down at Bakarun. Bakarun calmly parried, but his mind was in a hurry, thinking he must quickly return to the fleet.
If he was tied down by Luna now, he was sure he would suffer greater losses than the gains obtained through Eltiot.
"What? What are you doing, Bakarun? You were so confident when you dragged me into that strange space earlier; why are you retreating now?"
"Why are you aiding Eltiot, the god of the Clear Tribe? Moreover, you're not even fighting the royal family. Have you been defeated?"

"Why does that matter now? And as for the royal bastards, they'll be dealt with after you, so quit the nonsense. If you blabber again about Runcandel being defeated by creatures no better than insects, it won't be fun."
"Then you people should take your gains and leave. Today doesn't seem to be a lucky day for us."

"You try to kill us with that dreadful weapon and now you say let's go our separate ways? I can't do that, Bakarun. You seem to lack confidence; I'll talk to my youngest sibling. Tell them to stay out of it. You can use air fortresses or fleets or anything else."
Bakarun did not respond and continued to move towards the fleet.
This was a scene that clearly broke the morale of the enemy tribe. Their strongest tribesman, excluding the god, was retreating in front of everyone.
Of course, the high-ranking enemy tribesmen who knew how to read the situation recognized that Bakarun made the right decision, but there was no time to explain it to the lower ranks.
"Kaaa!"
Eventually, Luna thrust Krantel up, throwing Bakarun into the air.
As she leaped again to land a proper strike on Bakarun, she clenched her teeth as she saw his bracelet glowing.
"We'll decide the winner next time."
Krantel slashed through the air. Bakarun had teleported to the fleet using the return ability of his bracelet.
"We give up on Eltiot. We will support Patle and retreat!"
Bakalun, having returned to the bridge, quickly revised his orders.
Even if the morale was at its lowest, discipline did not disappear. Pibil and the fleet pilots immediately began moving rapidly towards Patlok.
And then, Luna descended to the ground. Her face was serene, as if she wasn't the person who had just ruthlessly pursued Bakalun.
"They're retreating, how is it? I tried following your style. By deliberately showing vulnerability, I made the opponent anxious, and the situation got easier."
Luna had never intended to settle the score with Bakalun, nor to have a final showdown with Pibil.

Eltielt was already secured by Jin, and those who had committed unspeakable acts with the body of the first generation family head were comfortably under Luke's protection. Naturally, they had to be dealt with more severely.
"From here, it felt quite real. If I were Bakalun, I'd be scared of seeing your face in my dreams tonight."
"Hehe, let's head to that guy named Luke. By the way, he's the god of the Clear Race. His name is Eltielt."
Jin unsheathed Sigmund, and deactivated its corrosion.
Then, the remnants of the ships, bound in energy, scattered in the sky. They were so shattered that it was hard to believe they had been ships, only ashes and particles remained.
Luna carried Eltielt. The siblings started running across the battlefield, but at that moment, the Sun God's shrine maiden, Sanna, was flustered.
Unexpectedly, the approach of Pibil's enemy brain wave caused the time to open the dimensional gate to extend.
Moreover, due to the sudden increase in magical concentration from all directions, there was a need to modify the prayer.
'Pibil's coming this way is one thing, but a sudden increase in magic concentration? Did Jin Runcandel notice something?'
Jin didn't precisely know that Sanna was trying to open a dimensional gate.
However, judging from the way Luke was buying time in battle, he speculated that preparations for teleportation, or something similar, were underway.
But he was certain that such teleportation, unlike Red Owl or Mort, had a time constraint. This meant that it was likely affected by the environment.
Therefore, he blindly dispersed magic power. If this troubled the enemies, good, otherwise he could simply retrieve the magic.
'But there's no problem. Anyway, High Priest Luke will buy us as much time as we need!'
And in that moment, Sanna looked up to suddenly see a streak of sword energy falling.
One strand of Runcandel's ultimate move, Meteor Rain, was piercing through Luke's protective barrier and descending into the pit below.
